meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑一次视觉核对,用截图确认界面改动是否正常。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完界面都要靠肉眼反复确认有没有走样。
copy.tagline_en: Check any UI change with screenshots and get a clear pass-or-fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep eyeballing every UI change to make sure nothing broke.

howto.what: 改完界面后,Claude 会按页面逐个截图取证,再派两个只读审查员独立核对,最后给出每个页面通过或不通过的结论;纯文本提取的检查不算数。
howto.when: 在你构建或改动任何界面之后、宣称完成之前触发;当你被问某个页面、组件或 TUI 是否正常时也会用。没有渲染界面的纯后端逻辑会跳过。

say.text: 帮我给这个页面做视觉 QA
say.note: 它会逐页截图并给出通过/不通过结论

say.text: 检查这个终端界面在 80 列下有没有溢出
say.note: 运行宽度检查并列出溢出与边框错位

say.text: 对比设计稿和实际页面,看我还原得对不对
say.note: 按同一视口截图做逐页比对

howto.what_en: After a UI change, Claude captures evidence per page, dispatches two read-only reviewers, and returns a per-page pass/fail verdict. Text extraction alone is not accepted as evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change any UI, before calling it done, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Skipped when there is no rendered surface.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on this page for me
say_en.note: It captures screenshots and returns a verdict

say_en.text: Check this TUI for overflow at 80 columns
say_en.note: Runs the width check and lists overflow and border issues

say_en.text: Compare the mock and the real page
say_en.note: Captures both at matching viewports and diffs them
